ScientificClaim.claimText: 1,445 mRNAs were identified as significantly differentially expressed between breast cancer and adjacent non-cancerous breast tissue samples, and 20 of these candidates have diagnostic performance with AUC greater than 0.9.

RationaleArtifact.rationaleText: The claim is based on the identification of 1,445 mRNAs that are significantly differentially expressed between breast cancer and adjacent non-cancerous breast tissue samples (EI-CS1-01). The diagnostic performance of these candidates was evaluated using ROC curve analysis, which identified 20 mRNAs with AUC greater than 0.9 (EI-CS1-02).
RationaleArtifact.keyEvidenceSummary: Exploratory identification of differentially expressed mRNAs and evaluation of their diagnostic performance.
uncertainties: The diagnostic performance of these mRNAs may not be generalizable to other populations or datasets.
Additional validation is required to confirm the clinical utility of these mRNAs as biomarkers.
